opening: Nothing you leave behind has your name on it. The city went on being the city, and you stopped being in it.

clauses.text: You kept moving the whole way through — block after block, none of them yours, none of them for long.
It was over before you had learned the shape of more than a street or two of it.
Behind you were rooms emptied down to the linings of drawers, and it had not been enough.
You had put down more of them than you could have named, and none of it bought you a day.
Twice and more the street had filled around you, and twice and more you had walked out of it — until the arithmetic of that stopped working.
You had known for days what was in you. Knowing it changed nothing except how the days felt.
There was water in that city. There is always water in a city. You simply ran out of the hours to find it in.
For whatever it is worth now, you did not take what was not yours to take, and you did not leave anyone where leaving them would have been easier.
There were things you did on the way here that you had stopped arguing with yourself about, and they did not save you either.
You were not the first that week and you were nowhere near the last. Names you never learned had gone out ahead of you, all over the map.
There was nobody with you at the end, and nobody looking.
Someone was still with you when it happened, which is more than most of this city managed.
The pack was beside you rather than on you, set down on purpose while you still could, which is not nothing to have got right at the end.
There are three words scratched on the wall above where you stopped, in your own hand, and they are a warning rather than a name.
The thing that had you did not outlast you. It is on the floor where you left it, and that was the last decision you got to make.
You went back over it at the end, in order, and it held together — which is more than most of what happens here does.
You did not fight the last of it. After everything you had spent fighting the rest, that reads less like giving up than like knowing the difference.
